headline: Enhance ClearInstall with AI-driven Risk Assessment
summary: Integrate AI algorithms to predict and mitigate risks associated with npm/PyPI package installations, including binding.gyp command expansion. Leverage machine learning models for enhanced security checks and real-time risk assessments.
actions: Implement an AI model that analyzes public repositories and historical data to identify potential vulnerabilities in packages before installation.
Develop a feature that uses natural language processing (NLP) to understand and flag complex package dependencies, such as those involving binding.gyp files.
Create a dynamic risk scoring system based on real-time threat intelligence feeds, providing users with actionable insights to avoid risky installations.
